# Scenario: DNS preflight with certs.publicIP
# If certs.publicIP is set, that IP must appear among dig's results.
# - If there is a mismatch (dig returns 127.0.0.1, certs.publicIP is 1.2.3.4):
#   Preflight fails, skipping certificate issuance (no retry, no downgrade).
# - If there is a match (dig returns 127.0.0.1, certs.publicIP is 127.0.0.1):
#   Preflight succeeds and certificate is successfully issued via Pebble.

pebble-start

# Step 1: Initialize Git repo
cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: dns preflight public IP fixture'
cd ..

# Step 2: Configure with MISMATCHING publicIP (e.g., 1.2.3.4)
cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'
exec sh -c 'echo "certs.publicIP=1.2.3.4" >> .apinfra'

chmod 0755 bin/dig
env PATH=$WORK/bin:$PATH

# Run agent - should skip due to mismatch
exec apinfra
stderr 'skip cert issue name=e2e-dns.apinfra.test'
! exists $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-dns.apinfra.test/fullchain.pem
! exists $HOME/.retries
! exists $HOME/.downgradeCertMode
! exists $HOME/.installedCert
! exists $HOME/.events
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1

# Step 3: Configure with MATCHING publicIP (127.0.0.1)
cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'
exec sh -c 'echo "certs.publicIP=127.0.0.1" >> .apinfra'

# Run agent - should succeed and issue certificate
exec apinfra
stderr 'cert issued name=e2e-dns.apinfra.test mode=prod'
stderr 'done duration='

exists $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-dns.apinfra.test/fullchain.pem
exists $HOME/infra/certbot/conf/live/e2e-dns.apinfra.test/privkey.pem
! exists $HOME/.downgradeCertMode
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-web-web-1

pebble-stop

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main
certs.provider=zerossl
certs.zerossl.AcmeKid=kid-1
certs.zerossl.AcmeHmac=zWNDZM6eQGHWpSRTPal5eIUYFTu7EajVIoguysqZ9wG44nMEtx3MUAsUDkMTQ12W
certs.zerossl.directory=https://127.0.0.1:14000/dir
certs.letsencrypt.directory=https://127.0.0.1:14000/dir
certs.letsencrypt.stagingDirectory=https://127.0.0.1:14000/dir

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-web
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        domain-name: e2e-dns.apinfra.test
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: prod
      cert-acme-email: e2e@apinfra.local

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-web/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: alpine:latest
    command: sh -c "while true; do echo -e 'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\n\n OK' | nc -lk -p 80; done"
    container_name: e2e-web-container

-- bin/dig --
#!/bin/sh
echo '127.0.0.1'

-- .env --
